balls.text: Shepherd sends this into orbit! Shepherd brings up a 14-ball fifty, and RCB finish on 213! Another slot ball outside off and this is just what Shepherd wants. He sits deep in his crease, goes through the line and smashes the living daylights out of this one. Clean strike over long off, and there are beaming smiles in the RCB camp, and why shouldn't there be!
taxi, where are you?! Haul that ball back, please! Right in the slot, tailing into leg stump. Shepherd gets his front foot out of the way and mooses it over cow corner!
four more! Misses the yorker on the shorter side on middle and off, and Pathirana travels. Shepherd clears his front leg and heaves it to long on's right!
fullish in the channel just outside off. Shepherd has an almighty swish at it and only swats away a few flies in the process. Lets out a cry of anguish, and he is audibly frustrated
Pathirana comes in for punishment too! Slower ball dragged half-way down the track. Shepherd spots it early and clobbers it to deep mid wicket's right!
zipped in very full on leg stump. David gets his feet out of the way and works it towards deep square leg. Just a single
33 off the over, and RCB have received a shot of impetus just before the final over! Another short ball outside off. Shepherd swings his blade like an axe and mows it over square leg

finally nails the yorker and gets it wide outside Shepherd's arc. He tries to dig it out but is just a little late in jamming his bat down. The batters have a chat and then review it. Shepherd was standing just a little outside off and the ball passes through inside the revised guideline. Non-wide call stays!

goodness gracious me - that is the shot of the night! And it is a No ball too. Khaleel has lost the plot completely here! Slower bumper outside off. Shepherd leaps up onto his toes like a salmon and creams it while being mid-air. Over the deep extra cover fence, and the wheels are coming off for Khaleel!
22 off the over already, and Khaleel has been ripped to shreds! Juicy full toss outside off and Shepherd needs no second invitation. He stands tall and bangs it over long off!

four more! Khaleel is leaking runs at the death again! Slower ball on a full length outside off. Shepherd swings himself off his feet and gets an outside edge that loops over Pathirana at short third!
back to back sixes! Right in the slot on middle and off, and Shepherd climbs into this. Swings through the line and boshes it over long off!
Shepherd goes big! Half-tracker outside off and this has hit-me all over it, written in caps. Shepherd lines it up and whacks it over deep mid wicket!

fullish on the pads and Shepherd gets away with this. Flicks it uppishly and it falls just in front of Kamboj at fine leg. A case could be made that Pathirana got away with this too, because of the line of the delivery

short and way outside off. Shepherd jumps up onto his toes to swish at it and misses. Wide not given but Shepherd wants to have another look. Seems to be beyond the tramlines on the first replay, and the umpire agrees with that assessment. Wide given!
get that head out of the way too! Pathirana welcomes the new batter with a bumper on off. Shepherd sizes it up early enough and sways away

straight to Sam Curran, and Pathirana takes down the RCB captain! Slower ball on a length wide outside off. With mid off up, Patidar fancies his chances but he cannot get the connection he wants. Scuffs it rather gently and Curran, stood right on the circle, does not err. CSK bag another, and RCB's captain departs after an uncharacteristically scratchy innings!
slower ball that goes wrong and slides well down leg. Patidar misses the full toss and Dhoni comes around to gather. Called a wide, of course
dug into the track and slanting further away because of the slingy action. Patidar has a waft at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air

did that carry?! Short outside off and David throws his hands at it. Cuts it uppishly, though, and Mhatre lets it slip through his hands. Replays indicate it might have just carried. How costly could that prove to be?
dug into the track on middle and leg. Patidar swipes at it but does not get the timing he desires. Cloths it tamely towards fine leg
floated up full on middle and leg. David plants his front foot and defends it to the bowler's right. Sets off for a single, only to be sent back. No damage done

a smart relay catch on the fence, and that will be that for Jitesh with the bat tonight! Dug into the track outside off and this sticks in the surface again. Jitesh has a swipe across the line but the lack of pace means the ball clunks off the toe-end. Curran runs around to his right at long on, takes the catch initially and then pops it to Brevis just as his momentum is about to take him past the rope! CSK chipping away nicely here!
well well! Fizzed in again, on a length on middle and off. Jitesh tries the reverse-swat this time but only swishes at thin air. Excellent take by Dhoni
back of a length outside off. Jitesh stays back and cuts it enough to deep point's left for a couple of runs
leg-spinner on a back of a length outside off. Jitesh, hanging back, looks to cut it away but the slight turn into him and the extra bounce beats him

googly on a back of a length on middle and off. Patidar shapes for the reverse but makes a bit of a mess. Off the pad towards short third. Might have grazed the bat before that, though, but given as runs
that is a cracking shot! Misses the yorker outside off by a smidgen and pays the price. Jitesh sits deep in his crease and blazes it between mid off and extra cover!
another short ball but this sails over the batter's head. Jitesh lets it go and the square leg umpire has no qualms in stretching out his arms
banged into the track on leg stump. Patidar hops around his crease and fends it down to fine leg. Rapid bumper that
slower bumper outside off and this bounces like a tennis ball, getting big on Jitesh. He swipes at it and splices it towards mid wicket
zipped in very full on leg stump. Seems to tail in late and Jitesh, trying to flick it away, ends up nutmegging himself
hard length on off and this skids onto Jitesh. A little hurried on the stroke and he dabs it tamely towards backward point

goes straight up, and taken comfortably by Jadeja this time! A touch poetic given Pathirana and Jadeja collided earlier in the day, which left Pathirana dazed momentarily. Back to the ball now. This was a slower ball, hung up wide outside off. Padikkal wanted to go inside-out but the lack of pace did for him. Got the elevation without any distance, and Jadeja made no mistake on the deep point fence!
he tries but he cannot get a hold of it! On the shorter side and this googly fizzes off the surface again outside off. Patidar shapes for the cut but only connects with fresh air
flighted up fullish outside off. Padikkal gets down on one knee and drags his sweep towards deep backward square leg
back of a length wide outside off. Patidar reaches out for it and swats it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
another googly, bowled slower and fuller on middle and off. Padikkal has a swing at it and jams it off the inside edge into the on side
googly on a back of a length outside off. Spins back into Patidar, tucks him up for room and he ends up shanking it back to the bowler
googly on a length outside off. Patidar tries to fetch it but can only clink it off the toe-end towards long off
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Patidar taps it enough to extra cover's right and keeps strike
slower bumper just outside off. Padikkal hops back and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
goes all the way now! Padikkal turning it on! Slower ball that lands right in the slot just outside off. Padikkal winds up and launches it over long on!
bang! Up and over! Back of a length outside off and Padikkal sets himself up for this. Opens up his stance and smacks it over mid off!

oh, what has happened there?! Slower delivery dug into the track on leg stump. Padikkal is at least a week early into his swing and gets smashed on the wrist. Whatever wearable he had on his wrist, flew off and was not far from the stumps
slower ball on a full length just outside off. Padikkal clears his front leg and powers it straight to mid off
back of a length just outside off. Patidar reads it off the surface and pushes it towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Another googly and Patidar fails to make contact with this one too. Perhaps beaten by the angle again
googly on a length just outside off. Patidar has a tentative prod at it this time and gets beaten by the angle across him
leg-spinner on a length just outside off. Grips in the surface and spins away, squaring up Padikkal. He gets an outside edge towards backward point
tossed up full and wide again. Patidar reaches out for it and squirts it off the inside edge into the on side

and Patidar says hello to him with a scorching boundary! Floated up full outside off. Patidar plants his front foot, gets his hands through the ball and razes it past extra cover. Long off, despite a dive, had no chance!
back of a length on middle and leg. Patidar drops it into the on side and looks at Padikkal, who responds and the single is completed

straight to Khaleel at backward point, and the Chinnaswamy is stunned! Slower bumper outside off and this bounces like a tennis ball. Kohli, thus, cannot control his dab and he cannot generate enough power to get it over the fielder either. An easy catch for Khaleel, who throws the ball into the turf to celebrate and Kohli throws his head back in disappointment, as do thousands of fans at the venue. Kohli walks back for 62, but not before he put on an absolute show!
on a length outside off. Padikkal pokes it towards mid off and scampers across to the other end
off-pace again, on a length wider outside off. Kohli slaps it down the ground to long off
oh dear - more sloppy work in the field! Slower ball on a full length on the stumps. Kohli marches down the track and drills it towards long off. Hooda makes an absolute meal of it and lets in four!
shortish outside off. Padikkal gets up on his toes and jabs it towards sweeper cover
four to end the over! This is a little into the slot outside off, again giving Kohli the freedom of his arms. He goes through the line and carves it over extra cover!
On the shorter side outside off and Kohli is just waiting for this. Picks the faster one, gets his hands through the ball and thrashes it past point. Brings up his fifty too!
fired across the batter wide outside off. Padikkal reaches out for it and squeezes it out to deep point
shortish again but a little closer to the stumps. Still wide enough to cut, although Padikkal cannot beat backward point with his attempt
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Beyond the tramlines and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise
back of a length on off. Spins away a touch and Kohli drops it into the off side for an easy single
Kohli is having none of this slowdown! He wants to dominate, and he wants to continue dominating! Tossed up into the slot on leg stump. Kohli gets down on one knee and clobbers it over wide long on!
edged! Fullish on middle and off. Padikkal plays for the ball to shape in but it moves away with the angle just enough to kiss the outside edge and dribble to short third, who was stood very fine

high into the night sky and pouched brilliantly by Brevis! Off-pace and into the track just outside off. Bethell has an enormous swipe across the line and miscues it. Brevis tracks it from deep mid wicket, runs his lungs out and then lunges forward to gobble up the chance inches off the turf. Wow, what a catch that is. Two in two for Brevis now, in terms of world-class catches, and CSK needed that moment of magic to break this opening stand!
slower ball on a length on off. Kohli is a little early into the stroke and flicks it towards fine leg
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Bethell reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep point
dug into the track just outside off. Bethell shapes for the pull but chunks it off the inside edge into his pads, with the ball eventually bobbling back to Pathirana
length ball on middle and off. Kohli presses half forward and tugs it towards deep square leg
back of a length on leg stump. Bethell has another mow and gets yet another inside edge. Onto the pads and the ball does not dribble away far enough to allow a single on this occasion
pushed in on a length on the pads. Kohli tucks it away towards deep backward square leg and is content with a single
back of a length outside off. Kohli stands tall and jabs it straight to extra cover
angled across on a back of a length outside off. Bethell has a hack at it and jams it off the inside edge into his back leg. The ball rolls away into the off side, allowing a sharp single

oh my word - what a shot that is! Fired in full outside off. Bethell brings out the reverse and even though he loses his footing, he lofts it cleanly over short third. A maiden IPL half-century for Bethell, and this might not be his last either!
back of a length on middle and leg. Kohli hangs back and knocks it to long on
slower bumper outside off. Kohli has to wait and wait for it before tugging it towards mid wicket. A bit of hesitation follows between the batters but the run is completed in the end
dispatched disdainfully! Slower ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Kohli picks the length and the variation early and slams it over deep mid wicket. All with a simple flick of the wrists!
back of a length delivery hung up wide outside off. Bethell reaches out for it and slices it towards deep backward point
hard length on middle and leg. Holds a little in the surface and Kohli stands up tall to punch it towards extra cover
fullish just outside off. Bethell comes forward and runs it down to deep backward point
Curran gets welcomed with a boundary! Back of a length and the width is the issue for CSK again. Bethell plays it late and with an open bat face, gliding it past backward point for four!
back of a length on middle and leg. Comes in with the arm and Kohli stabs it towards mid wicket
fired in shorter on middle and off. Kohli makes room for the cut but there is enough bite off the surface for the ball to go past his flailing blade
fizzed in on a length on middle and leg. Straightens against the angle again and kisses the leading edge of Kohli's bat, rolling towards short third
short outside off. Bethell waits for it and cuts it towards deep point
fuller and flatter on the stumps. Kohli comes forward and knocks it to long off
spin straightaway! Back of a length just outside off. Grips in the surface and spins away, beating Kohli on the outside as he swishes at it
pushed in full on middle and leg. Kohli gets onto the front foot and flicks it towards deep mid wicket. Single to end the powerplay
fullish delivery hung up wide outside off. Kohli has a huge waft at it but only grabs a handful of fresh air
full on middle and off. Kohli steps outside leg, creates room for himself and drills it towards extra cover, who reins it in with a smart dive to his left
shortish and slanting into middle and leg. Kohli looks to work to leg but plays all around it (for a change). The ball thuds into his thigh pad
four more! CSK are bleeding runs, left, right and centre! Zipped in fuller just outside leg. Kohli skips down the track and blasts it past mid on!
and Kohli takes him to the cleaners first ball! Tries to follow the batter outside leg but this is right in the slot. Kohli brings those strong wrists into play and whips it over deep square leg!
oh dear - that is a wretched delivery! A proper buffet ball. A waist-high full toss laced with width and Bethell plunders it between extra cover and mid off!
flighted up full outside off. Bethell looks to drive down the ground and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket
watch that white ball sail! Dragged down on middle stump and Bethell is all over it like a rash. Rocks deep into his crease and pummels it a country mile over deep mid wicket. A 99m six!
Bethell finds the fence, and Noor is not being spared either! Googly tossed up full outside off. Bethell gets down on one knee and muscles it past mid wicket!
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Bethell goes back and jabs it towards point
floated up full and wide. Bethell stretches out for it and drills it straight to cover. He will feel he missed out there
another top shot! Back of a length outside off and the width is the problem here. Kohli sits deep in his crease and thunders it between cover point and extra cover!

goes straight up, and there is a terrible, terrible collision between two CSK players! Back of a length just outside off. Bethell has a swipe across the line and the ball spoons up off the leading edge. Jadeja goes after it from inside the circle and Pathirana runs forward too from deep backward point. Both of them have eyes on the ball and are not aware of the other hurtling in their direction. The catch gets spilled, and Pathirana seems to have bumped into Jadeja. This is not a good look and let's hope Pathirana is alright.
back of a length just outside off. Kohli drops it into the off side and looks at his partner, who responds and dashes across to complete the run
short and wide outside off, perhaps a response to Kohli backing away early. He has a swish at it but cannot reach it
safe again! Hard length, angling across the batter just outside off. Bethell has a tug at it and skews it just to the right of the fielder at cover point. Brevis flung himself but could not get there
gorgeous, gorgeous stroke! Fullish on middle and off. Bethell plants his front foot, shows the maker's name and cracks it back past the bowler. An on-drive of the highest order!

back to back sixes for Virat Kohli, and the roof is coming off the Chinnaswamy! Fullish ball down leg and that is just begging to be hit. Kohli presses forward, snaps his wrists into action and clips it cleanly over the deep square leg fence!

smashed into the top tier! Banged into the track just outside off and Kohli, after the short-ball barrage the last time he faced Khaleel, knows this is coming. He swivels and hooks it a mile over fine leg!
short and wide outside off. Bethell throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep backward point
back of a length outside off and this skids off the surface. Bethell shapes to cut but is beaten for pace. Good comeback by the pacer
fetch that, says Jacob Bethell! Marginally short outside off and Bethell pounces. Picks the length early, stands up on his toes and dumps it over the deep mid wicket fence!
fullish just outside off. Seems to stick in the surface a touch and Bethell scuffs his off-drive towards mid off
back of a length outside off. Swings away a touch and Kohli, hanging back in his crease, taps it gently into the off side

miscued but it lands safe! Hard length on middle and leg. Skips off the surface and bounces a bit extra. Gets big on Bethell as he looks to pull but luckily for him, he gets it enough to Noor's left at mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Kohli gets forward, tips it to mid off and hares across to the other end. Off the mark at the first time of asking
fullish on off, shaping back in slightly. Bethell takes a step down the track and pushes it towards mid off for a single
on a length, shaping a touch into middle stump. Bethell presses half forward and defends. Not sure he was expecting that swing
oh! Back of a length in the channel. Nibbles away a smidgen after pitching and Bethell, feeling for it, is beaten on the outside
angled in on a length on off. Straightens a touch after pitching and Bethell gets squared up. Plonks it off the leading edge towards deep backward point

third four in a row - Bethell is on the charge early! Half-volley outside off and Bethell makes the most of it. He drives with a slightly open bat face and threads it between cover point and backward point!

four more! Back of a length outside off. Bethell gets up on his toes and opens his bat face at the last moment to guide it past slip. Fine enough for deep third too, despite Pathirana sprawling to his right!
short, wide and punished! RCB are underway! This is a proper hit-me ball. Sits up nicely and Bethell frees his arms with abandon, crashing it through point!
back of a length, pitching outside off and decking back in sharply. Bethell watches the ball right onto his bat and dabs it towards backward point
full and angling into the batter just outside off. Bethell comes forward and pushes it towards mid off. Just a hint of in-swing

Dayal wins it for RCB again! Up against the five-time champions, Dayal shows that he is a champion to be reckoned with too. Under extreme pressure, and under extreme duress, RCB pull a win out of the fire, and they are going absolutely bonkers. It was proper carnage at the Chinnaswamy and after 40 overs of high-octane cricket, RCB stand atop the team that has caused them so much pain in the past! Full toss just outside off. Dube clears his front leg and swings for the hills. Cannot get under it and cannot find the gap either. Drilled straight to long on and that will be just a single. Spare a thought for CSK. They came so close, but in the end, fell short. A truly remarkable game of cricket, and one that those at the ground will reminisce and rejoice in years to come!
zipped in very full on off. Jadeja looks to go downtown but can only find the inside edge and then the front pad. Rolls away harmlessly into the off side
full toss just outside off. Dube swings at it with all his might and scuffs it down the ground to long off. Just a single, and the onus shifts back onto Jadeja

that is a high full toss and Dube smashes it out of sight! Borderline waist-high full toss outside off and Dube cannot believe what has been dished out. After scratching his eyes, he thumps it over deep mid wicket. No ball not given, and Dube has reviewed this. This could be touch-and-go! Dube's waist is measured at 1.11m, and Ball Tracking shows the ball to be passing him at 1.14m. That will be a No ball - oh dearie me!

massive lbw shout, and the finger goes up! No MS Dhoni magic at the Chinnaswamy tonight! Low full toss slanting into leg stump. Dhoni has a massive swipe at it but does not get any bat on it. Gets rapped on the pads and the finger goes up. Dhoni has reviewed this but it could be more in hope than anything else. The impact is in line and Ball Tracking has the ball crashing into leg stump. A monumental moment in this game, and Dayal has outwitted Dhoni two years in a row at the Chinnaswamy!
full toss on middle and leg and Jadeja cannot put it away. Drags it towards deep mid wicket and this over has begun with two singles off two balls
low full toss on middle and leg. Dhoni cannot get under this and scuffs it down the ground to long on. Throws his head back in disappointment soon after
low full toss slanting into off stump. Dhoni tugs at this a little and drags it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single to finish the over
Dhoni with a phenomenal hit over extra cover! And that is vintage Dhoni! Back of a length wide outside off. Dhoni picks the line early, stands up tall and creams it over the deep cover fence!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Jadeja cannot get under this either and squirms it towards long off
low full toss just outside off. Dhoni cannot get under it and muscles it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single
full toss on the pads. Jadeja swings at it and misses, with the ball rolling off his front pad into the off side. Given as runs. Maybe Jadeja got something on it, after all

Kohli drops an absolute soda now, and RCB eyes cannot believe what they have just witnessed! Full on midde and off. Jadeja bends his back knee to get under it and arrows it straight to Kohli. The ball goes through his hands and not sure what happened there. Another pure moment of drama!
fired in full just outside off. Jadeja flicks it down the ground towards long on and settles for a single. Just six off the over and that could be a game-changing over

just safe! Not sure that carried! Back of a length outside off. Jadeja has a massive mow at it and cuts across it too much. David rushes in from long off, dives forward but cannot make it stick. Might not have carried too. Suyash is disappointed, as are those in RCB colours at the ground
shortens the length after sensing Dhoni advance. Dhoni chops it into the off side and that will be just another single
shortish outside off. Jadeja opens up his stance and flat-bats it towards long off
back of a length just outside off. Skids off the surface and Jadeja hacks it back to the bowler
back of a length outside off. Dhoni goes back and taps it towards deep cover. Jadeja back on strike to the leg-spinner
excellent slower ball to finish off. Dips devilishly just outside off and Jadeja, looking to sweep it away, is beaten all ends up. Lucky for him that was not on the stumps...

oh goodness gracious me - Jadeja has smashed that onto the roof of the Chinnaswamy! This is another yorker that has gone wrong and ends up being a juicy full toss. Jadeja lines it up and clatters it an absolute mile over cow corner. A 109m six, and we might need to contact NASA to get that one back!
full ball sliding into the pads. Dhoni glances it towards short fine leg and Jadeja calls him through for a single

rapped in front and the finger goes up! Brevis dismissed first ball and Ngidi is making the Chinnaswamy his stage here! Full toss slanted into leg. Brevis has a hack across the line and misses it completely. Pinned on the pads and the umpire had no hesitation in raising his finger. Brevis wants to have another look. But it looks like he has run out of time. Seems like the ball would have gone down leg. Jadeja is not happy with how things have unfolded, but CSK are four down, and Brevis has to walk back for a gloden duck! More drama at the Chinnaswamy, and Ngidi has two in two, out of nowhere!

goes a mile up, and Mhatre perishes! The Chinnaswamy finds its voice, and this game is threatening to twist and turn again! Slower ball on a length outside off. Mhatre cannot resist the temptation to have a pop at it and slogs across the line. Miscues it because of the lack of pace and only gets height on it. Krunal calls for it, runs around to his left from deep mid wicket and snares the chance. A standing ovation from those in yellow, at the ground and in front of millions of screens, and this is an innings that this boy will remember for a long, long time!
full toss outside off and that may be treated by Jadeja as a missed opportunity. Gets down on the sweep and cloths it on the bounce to deep mid wicket

oh dear - RCB put down another chance, and CSK fans are having a right-old party in the stands! Slower bumper on leg stump that takes three business weeks to arrive. Jadeja plays three strokes in his head and then makes contact with his fourth and actual attempt at a pull. Spoons it towards Ngidi at fine leg, who tries to take it too low and then shells it. This game keeps on producing telling moments!
straight as you like, and Jadeja is not relenting! Right in the slot just outside off. Jadeja plants his front foot and pulverizes it over the bowler's head!
this is wide again, even though it is a full toss, and Dayal has the field set for that sort of stroke. Mhatre hangs back and jabs it towards sweeper cover

dropped by Patidar - oh dear, that could be an enormous moment in the game! Off-pace and angled across the batter outside off. Mhatre swings himself off his feet and slices across it too much. Patidar back-pedals at extra cover, tries to take it over his shoulder but the ball pops out!
slow and short outside off, and Jadeja cuts it straight to deep point. Jadeja lets out a cry of frustration. He should have put that away

full toss slanting into the stumps. Jadeja opens up his stance and drills it to long on's left. The fielder tears across to his left and puts in a full-length dive to save two. Shepherd was the man on the fence

oh my goodness - hang that in the Louvre, and bow down to this youngster! Misses the wide yorker by the smallest of margins and Mhatre climbs into it. Steps across his stumps and with all the wait on the back foot, he crrrrrrrrrunnnnnnnchhhhhesssss it over extra cover!

full toss just outside off. Jadeja plants his front foot and drives it down the ground to long on. Fifty up for Jadeja - just his fifth in the IPL, and this has come off 29 balls. And the sword celebration comes out too!
low full toss wide outside off. Mhatre jams it out towards sweeper cover. Just another single
shortish and wide outside off. Jadeja throws his hands at it and cuts it towards deep point. Just a single
into the blockhole on middle and off. Right under the bat and Jadeja can only clink it off the toe-end towards the bowler. Massive dot ball
almost a yorker outside off. Mhatre cannot get under it enough and powers it on the bounce to long off
slower ball on a full length on the pads. Jadeja drop-kicks it to the edge of the ring in the mid on region and calls for two early. Both saunter back in the end

Jadeja finds the fence, just when CSK needed him to! Ngidi aims to hurl this at Jadeja's toes but gets it a little too down leg. Jadeja finds the faintest of tickles and by extension, finds a much-needed boundary!
low full toss just outside off. Mhatre, sitting deep in his crease, shovels it towards deep mid wicket
full toss on middle and off, and Jadeja will feel he missed out there. Skips down the track and drills it towards mid off, who stops it with a slide to his left
slower ball on a full length on off. Mhatre lets the ball dip on him before driving it down the ground to long off
into the blockhole outside off and it seems Ngidi has read Jadeja's intentions to scoop it. Jadeja has to adjust and digs it out into the off side
Mhatre finishes the over with a boundary! Floated up into the slot on off. Mhatre gets down on one knee and blitzes it to long on's right!
short and wide outside off. Mhatre again loses his shape trying to smash the cover off the ball and only swishes at thin air
tossed up on a fullish length just outside off. Mhatre tries to hit it too hard and drags it towards long on
back of a length outside off. Mhatre winds up and flat-bats it down the ground towards long off. David comes screeching across to his right and saves two
hits it too straight! Tossed up into the slot outside off. Jadeja plants his front foot and hits it like a bullet, but straight into the stumps at the other end. Just a single to long off
splits the field to perfection! On the shorter side and laced with width. Jadeja stays put deep inside his crease and knifes it between point and backward point!
another top yorker on leg stump. Jadeja squeezes it out to long on and has to settle for a single. Brilliant over by Dayal!
full and wide outside off. Mhatre has a wild slog across the line and skews it off the outside edge towards deep backward point
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Jadeja digs it out into the mid wicket region and wants two. Mhatre, though, cannot come back because he had to navigate past the bowler while running the first
slow and short outside off. Mhatre reaches out for it and slaps it towards sweeper cover
full and speared across the batter outside off. Mhatre has another swish but this time, is a tad late on the stroke
fullish and angling across the batter outside off. Mhatre throws his hands at it and slices it over extra cover. Bethell nearly over-runs it on the fence but recovers in time to keep it to a brace
tossed up on a length outside off. Mhatre guides it towards backward point and looks at Jadeja, who responds to his call. Single completed comfortably enough
back of a length on middle and off. Jadeja works it towards deep mid wicket
what timing! That has sped to the fence! Googly on a back of a length outside off and this sits up a little. Jadeja waits for it and caresses it past extra cover!

in the air but just enough to short third's left! Back of a length outside off and this bounces a touch extra. Jadeja slashes at it and the ball hangs agonizingly in the air. Ngidi sprawls to his left but cannot quite get there
Jadeja wants a piece of the six-hitting fun too! Dragged down outside off and Jadeja cashes in. Rocks back and pounds it flat over wide long on!
fired in full on leg stump. Mhatre gets onto the front foot and flicks it towards long on
shortish outside off. Mhatre has a big swish at it and skews it off the outside edge towards deep third. Just a single this time

lovely, lovely batting! No pre-meditation so far, and Mhatre is just reacting to what is being dished out. This is a full toss outside off and he holds his shape to time it exquisitely between extra cover and mid off!

watch out in Cubbon Park, because this ball is headed straight to you! Banged into the track on the stumps and Mhatre spots this incredibly early. Opens up his stance and clatters it a mile over deep mid wicket. A 98m six!
hard length on middle and off. Mhatre stays leg side of the ball and pats it towards extra cover
swiped flat into the stands! Slower bumper that sits up nicely on leg stump. Mhatre picks it early and deposits it over deep backward square leg!
shortish on leg stump. Jadeja hops up onto his toes and tugs it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Jadeja sits deep in his crease and taps it towards backward point for a sharpish single
on a length on middle and off. Mhatre hangs back and stabs it towards deep mid wicket, and he brings up his maiden IPL half-century. What a knock this has been!
googly on a back of a length outside off. Jadeja stays back and dabs it towards backward point
right in the gap! Shortish and spinning in towards middle and off. Jadeja takes a step deep into his crease early and muscles it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
googly on a back of a length on off. Mhatre picks it off the pitch and drives it on the up past the bowler for a run
back of a length outside off. Jadeja goes back and punches it towards deep point
off-pace on a length just outside leg. Jadeja advances but does not read the slower one. Has to check his shot and plonks it towards mid off for a single
that is a Ravindra Jadeja special! On the shorter side on middle and leg. Jadeja backs away very early, creates room and scythes it past backward point!
safe! Slower ball on a full length outside off. Mhatre swings at it with all his might and slices it on the bounce to sweeper cover
slower ball on a full length on middle and leg. Jadeja nurdles it to mid wicket and calls for the single early this time. Mhatre scampers across to complete it

oh dear - hesitation out in the middle! Fullish and following the batter outside leg as he steps out. Jadeja flicks it towards mid wicket and is hell-bent on the single. Mhatre takes a couple of strides too before getting sent back. No damage done in the end
Jadeja starts the over with a boundary! Shortish on off. Jadeja backs away early and throws the plumbing at it, flaying it to deep third's right!

miscued, but that carries all the way! Fast bouncer on leg stump and that takes Mhatre by complete surprise. He swipes at it, more in hope than anything else, and gets a top edge that flies over the keeper's head. He will not mind it, though!
back of a length on off. Jadeja hangs back and turns it towards deep backward square leg
slanted in on a length on the stumps. Mhatre clears his front leg and drills it back past the bowler. Kohli comes around from long on and cuts it off, with his quick release also denying the second
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja stays leg side of the ball and dabs it towards deep backward point
angled in fuller on leg stump. Mhatre gets down on one knee and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket
fullish on middle and off. Mhatre gets forward and plays it towards extra cover
back of a length outside off. Jadeja sits deep in his crease and jabs it towards extra cover
well well! Fullish just outside off. Jadeja skips down the track first ball and shanks it towards mid wicket. Early sign of intent...

an ugly heave across the line, and Curran bites the dust! Back of a length on middle and leg. Climbs onto Curran and he can exert no control over this attempted swipe. The ball goes straight up off the top edge and Jitesh calls early to complete the easiest of catches. The dream start for Ngidi, and CSK, after blitzing out of the traps, have hit a bit of a snag!

dug into the track just outside off. Curran hops up onto his toes again and tugs it towards mid on. Mhatre wanted the single but Curran said no. The youngster, understandably, itching to get back on strike
hard length on middle and leg. Curran gets up on his toes and pats it back to the bowler
back of a length outside off. Mhatre throws the kitchen sink at it and slices it towards deep backward point
angled in on a back of a length on leg stump. Mhatre knocks it to long on and keeps strike
back of a length on off. Curran waits for it and punches it towards deep mid wicket
tries to surprise Curran with a bouncer but he reads it like the morning daily! Picks it up early, opens up his front hip and bludgeons it to mid on's left!

straight to backward point, and Krunal, like he so often does, breaks through for RCB! Darted in full and wide. Rasheed's eyes light up and he throws his hands at it. Slices it uppishly and that brings the fielder in the ring into play. Simple enough catch for Shepherd and Krunal is absolutely pumped. CSK's blistering opening stand is halted at 51, but they have something to build on now!
slower on a length just outside off. Mhatre shapes to go inside-out aerially at first but has to change his stroke after getting deceived in the air. Jabs it towards point for a single
back of a length on middle and leg. Rasheed punches it to mid on and calls for the single. Could have been tight but he gets helped massively by a misfield
26 off the over, and this boy's a star! Back of a length just outside off. Mhatre waits for it calmly, opens his bat face and glides it beautifully between backward point and short third!

through the gap now - Mhatre is enjoying himself at the Chinnaswamy! Back of a length, designed to follow Mhatre outside leg. He still creates room for himself too and finds the gap between extra cover and mid off!
Mhatre goes all the way now! 17 years old, and he is oozing confidence! Dug in shorter outside off and this sits up for Mhatre. He stands up tall again and pummels it over mid on!
three fours in a row! Attempted slower yorker that ends up as a juicy full toss outside off. Mhatre picks it early and bulldozes it past mid on!
four more! Bhuvneshwar looks for the off-stump yorker but errs on the shorter side. That makes it, more or less, a slot ball and Mhatre pumps it over the bowler's head!
that is some shot! Hard length outside off. Mhatre stands up tall on his toes and bashes it over the bowler's head. Not the most well-timed, but quite brave!

follows up the four with a six! Short again and on the hips, which makes this a tailor-made ball for that pick-up pull behind square. Rasheed gets into position early and smashes it flat over the fine leg fence!

Rasheed with his first boundary and that will ease a few nerves! Short ball down leg. Perhaps designed to follow the batter again but that was so far down that Rasheed could help it fine of deep backward square leg!
follows the batter outside leg with a shortish ball. Rasheed is tucked up for room and chunks his pull into his body
almost a wicket! Hard length on middle and off. Skids off the surface and gets big on Mhatre as he looks to pull. Cloths it uppishly and Dayal nearly makes it stick with his left hand
shortish on the hips. Rasheed gets inside the line and pulls it on the bounce to deep backward square leg. Rasheed will feel he missed out there
short and wide outside off. Rasheed has a pop at it but ends up chopping it towards short third
back of a length outside off. Mhatre has an ungainly hack at it and cloths it on the bounce to mid on
angled in on a length on middle and off. Mhatre stays leg side of the ball and plays it back to the bowler
deft touch! Back of a length outside off. Mhatre seems to wind up to go downtown initially before changing his stroke. Plays it late and then steers it between backward point and short third!
back of a length outside off. Rasheed waits for it and drops it into the off side for an easy single
back of a length outside off. Rasheed has a tentative stab at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
back of a length outside off. Shapes away slightly and Rasheed gets up on his toes to punch it towards extra cover
back of a length on leg stump. Rasheed uses the pace and glances it towards short fine leg. Ngidi dives smartly to his left and ensures it is just a single
fired in full on leg stump. Mhatre has a swing at this too and squirts it off the inside edge towards square leg
Mhatre lands his first punch! Floatier and into the slot just outside off. Mhatre gets down on one knee early and bangs it over the bowler's head!
pushed in again, on a length just outside off. Comes in with the arm and Mhatre taps it tamely towards the bowler
flighted up a little more and much fuller on leg stump. Mhatre plays all around this and gets pinged on the pads
darted in on a length on off. Comes in with the arm and Mhatre hurriedly jams it off the inside edge into his pads
